name: flowershow
description: Publish what you made in an AI session as a live website: Markdown, HTML pages, notes and docs, with or without an account.

interface.longDescription: Turn what you made in this session into a live website. Ask Codex to publish this, put this online, or share this as a website: Flowershow publishes Markdown, HTML pages (reports, dashboards, one-pagers), notes and docs and gives you a URL. No account needed to start; claim the site to keep it. Also configures existing sites (custom domain, CSS, comments, search).
